name: Returnal Line
acquisitionSource: Clear Interlude - Verboten Covenant: The Outer Sea

setEffects.descriptionTemplate: Team Unique: At the start of battle, gain {STR} equal to 12% of the wielder's ATK. If the current Realm is {Aequor}, instead gain the following effect: “At the start of each turn, there is a (50 + 0.25 × the team's Realm Mastery)% chance to gain 1 stack of Tentacle Gathering. If this chance exceeds 100%, multiple stacks can be gained. This chance is doubled in Boss Battles.”

lore: Rise once more, O sunken city fated for rebirth. Return to us, @3!
